metadata.description: AsterGuard security-engineer skills and the companion packages they drive — local, agent-native application security for AI agents.

plugins.name: asterguard-security
plugins.description: Agent-native AppSec for a security engineer: perform a scan locally and build the SCA graph, data-flow, information-flow (IFC) and weakness graph as skill capabilities, then generate DAST + behavioral red-team tests, judge them, and emit a risk report — no AsterGuard server required.

packages.comment: Companion binaries the skills shell out to as raw collectors. local-scan bootstraps whichever are missing; the skills do the analysis.
